query.scope: Exact supplied bot/workspace; JOIN bots and coordinator_bots on botId, ownerId and workspaceId; matching bot_model_choices only.

findings.name: preflight_gate
findings.detail: Current must be chosen=true, available=true, no fallback, string id and present in offered groups. sameModel also compares chosen during restoration.

findings.name: source_of_truth
findings.detail: The preference is bot_model_choices keyed by ownerId/workspaceId/botKey. Explicit bot ID is the key; it is not a bots.model field. Missing row means selected undefined and no saved API key choice.

findings.name: implicit_default
findings.detail: With no saved preference, default resolution can select an effective subscription/hosted choice but chosen remains false. Reading the menu does not save that default.

findings.name: normal_restore_contract
findings.detail: PUT requires a nonempty option id. HOSTED_CHOICE writes a row with no binding, deliberately explicit hosted choice. null/auto is rejected by setBotModel. Restoring a displayed default id would preserve neither absent-row state nor chosen=false.

findings.name: explicit_default_is_different
findings.detail: A row with no binding/key is an explicitly saved hosted default and can be chosen=true; it must not be confused with the observed absent preference row.

findings.name: closed_production_result
findings.detail: At the one query snapshot the trusted target matches exactly one Coordinator and has zero preference rows. If unchanged when the menu is read, current chosen=false fails the existing restoration gate. No effective provider/model or quota availability was queried.

supplementaryCodeSearch.limit: This exact SQL text search is supplementary, not an exhaustive proof of every possible ORM operation. The supported GET/PUT call chain itself has no unset operation.

conclusion: This gate is not safely solved by relabeling an implicit default as an explicit choice. No driver change or setting mutation was made. Root can evaluate a supported exact restoration operation separately; no reset API is introduced here.
remainingUnknown: Effective live menu/provider/model/availability/fallback were not queried.
Concurrent normal user activity may change the saved preference after this point-in-time read.
Legacy coordinator-key migration is a separate normal code path; no additional production row scan was authorized or performed.
